findings.text: the citation for the terminal vocabulary anchors recovery.py:72-76, but TERMINAL_MANIFEST_STATUSES is defined at recovery.py:87 and lines 72-76 are RECOVERY_CLASSES members (running/waiting/.../abandoned), so a reader following the citation sees a different distinguished set than the sentence cites; the claim itself (complete, blocked, failed) is correct at :87.

the deadlock result is recorded only as prose — the probe log named in the manifest (/tmp/reuse-map-deadlock-probe.log) is 0 bytes because block-buffered pytest output dies with the timeout kill, so the "exit 124" claim carries no receipt in the artifact; an independent 130 s probe reproduced exit 124 at the surveyed base, so the claim is right but the numeric code should live in the report text itself.

the report is unguarded — no test asserts over the crew/reports directory (the directory is not a git repository either), so a later edit to a verdict or a citation can silently contradict the tree it describes; the same weakness was recorded for the wave-and-soft-limit map in the review of r-20260914T125035036163.

justifications.durability: nothing reads this report — no test asserts over the crew/reports directory and it is not a git repository, so an edited verdict or a citation pointing at a line that no longer exists fails nothing; the same weakness was scored 5 in the review of the sibling reuse map.
justifications.evidence: every load-bearing reproduction independently reproduced: the watch test at tests/test_crew.py:1806 rode a 130 s timeout to exit 124 in a fresh probe, the run-on status produced by reports.py:129-131 made manifest_status_is_terminal False and classify_pointer return abandoned with "redispatch if needed" (recovery.py:1614-1641), the fixture scan found zero column-0 bullets directly under status: across 263 test files, the commits field parsed clean beside the unusable status, and every sampled citation resolved to its claimed content.
justifications.fit: the map follows the reuse-map idiom of crew/reports/display-truth-reuse-wave-soft-limit.md with a settled satisfied/partial/absent vocabulary and per-section write-path tables naming the asserting test files, and introduces no plan, sprint or ticket label into the filename or content; it is docked for the recovery.py:72-76 anchor that names RECOVERY_CLASSES members rather than TERMINAL_MANIFEST_STATUSES at recovery.py:87.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the report maps all nine measure rows of the §15 and §16 tables at the surveyed base 5384182 (6 in §15, 3 in §16 — verified against the plan HTML at that base, whose extra §15 rows are 2026-09-14 additions absent from the surveyed revision), one row per measure with a satisfied/partial/absent verdict, a file:line citation on every satisfied and partial verdict, and the stated count 9 matches the gate expectation.
justifications.scope_discipline: the node wrote exactly one path, its declared write path /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/reports/display-truth-reuse-refusal-classifier.md, made no commit because that directory is not a git repository, and recorded that honestly in the manifest rather than claiming one.
